name: mcal_sync
description: Pull a calendar's linked Google calendar into Metalcraft Calendar (`calendar` slug), reconciling recent changes so a subsequent mcal_list_events reflects the latest. Call before answering 'what's on my calendar?' when freshness matters (events may have been added in Google directly). Returns { synced: <count reconciled> }. No-op if the calendar has no linked Google calendar. Works with a read or write token.
